没想到这个游戏居然能推出续作。《坤化危机2》是一款主打玩梗的第三人称射击游戏，游戏中大量的网络梗。选择网络梗是一个很冒险的做法，因为梗的淘汰速度非常快，就像很多其他的玩梗游戏一样，题材具有时效性，可能过段时间就因为题材而被淘汰了。 本作游戏的玩法很像是那种丧尸射击游戏，只不过敌人的模型全都是坤坤。游戏采用了防守的玩法，大量的各种形态的敌人会不断涌向玩家，玩家只能使用手中的远程枪械和近战武器将他们全部击杀来完成波次。 除去传统的攻击手段之外，有些还包含了一个技能槽，其中也包含威力强大，范围广阔的大型杀伤技能。玩家可以通过普通方式击杀敌人来累积技能槽，从而在槽满的时候释放大型的技能来获取战斗的优势。同时击杀敌人还可以获得金钱奖励，玩家可以在波次的间歇期间使用金钱购买BUFF和武器，以及补给弹药，从而提升玩家在接下来的战斗中的续航能力和更高的伤害，尽可能地多生存几个波次。 本作游戏比起前作最大的改动是加入了联机合作的玩法，玩家不再孤单地孤军奋战了，加入了联机的玩法更欢乐，也更有直播效果。同时联机模式下玩家游戏的难度也会降低不少。 [table][td][b]欢迎关注我们 [/b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/10591434/]突突突发糖辣！[/url] [/td][/table]

KUNKUN Defender 2 from Seal is a chaotic hybrid that blends third-person shooting with tower defense elements, but what really defines it is not its mechanics alone—it’s the unapologetically absurd tone that runs through the entire experience. The game doesn’t aim for realism or narrative depth; instead, it focuses on delivering fast, exaggerated action wrapped in a layer of meme-driven humor. This approach gives it a distinct identity, making it feel less like a conventional defense game and more like a deliberately over-the-top survival sandbox. At its core, the gameplay revolves around holding out against waves of enemies in contained environments, with the ultimate goal of surviving long enough for extraction. Unlike traditional tower defense titles where strategy revolves around building and upgrading static defenses, KUNKUN Defender 2 places players directly in the action. You’re constantly moving, aiming, and reacting in real time, using a variety of weapons to keep the growing hordes at bay. Defensive elements exist, but they serve more as support systems rather than the primary focus, creating a balance between planning and immediate combat that keeps the experience active and engaging. Combat itself is designed to be loud, fast, and chaotic. Weapons feel powerful, enemies appear in large numbers, and encounters quickly escalate into frantic battles where positioning and awareness matter just as much as firepower. The inclusion of different character roles adds some variety, allowing players to approach encounters in slightly different ways depending on their preferred playstyle. While the underlying mechanics are not especially deep, they are responsive enough to make the moment-to-moment gameplay satisfying, particularly when everything on screen descends into controlled chaos. One of the game’s most notable strengths is its cooperative play. When played with others, the experience becomes significantly more dynamic, as players coordinate to cover different angles, manage resources, and survive increasingly difficult waves together. The shared objective of holding out until extraction creates a natural sense of tension, and the unpredictability of multiplayer sessions helps keep the gameplay fresh. In contrast, solo play can feel more repetitive, as it lacks the emergent moments that come from interacting with other players. Despite its energy, the game does have clear limitations. The core loop, while fun, does not evolve substantially over time. Maps and objectives remain relatively consistent, and although there are some variations in enemy types and layouts, the overall structure of each session feels familiar after only a few runs. Progression systems offer incremental improvements, but they do little to fundamentally change how the game is played, which can make long-term engagement feel somewhat shallow. The presentation reflects the game’s tone, leaning heavily into exaggerated humor and meme-inspired elements. Character designs, dialogue, and overall style are intentionally unconventional, creating a playful but sometimes disjointed atmosphere. For players who appreciate this kind of humor, it adds to the charm and makes the game stand out. For others, it may feel inconsistent or even distracting, especially when combined with visuals that prioritize functionality over polish. Ultimately, KUNKUN Defender 2 succeeds by focusing on immediate enjoyment rather than long-term depth. It delivers short bursts of frantic, cooperative action that are easy to jump into and fun to experience, especially with friends. At the same time, its limited variety and repetitive structure prevent it from sustaining that excitement over extended periods. In the end, it stands as a lively and unconventional indie title that knows exactly what it wants to be. It may not offer the complexity or refinement of larger games in the genre, but it compensates with personality and chaotic energy, making it a worthwhile experience for players looking for something lighthearted and action-packed. Rating: 8/10
